From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>

Cc: Elena P. <elena@peopleops-training.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: People Lead orientation & sensitive-HR playbook — pilot session scheduling

Hi team —

Following our Q4 retro and the org changes coming in March, I want to run a focused orientation for newly promoted people leads (first cohort, ~8) that combines:
- a short primer on Redwood performance review policy (new calibration notes)
- practical coaching on difficult conversations (roleplay + feedback)
- escalation paths and documentation hygiene for P1 people issues

Elena from PeopleOps has a ready-made 3-hour pilot we can adapt. Elena — could you share a draft agenda and your recommended faculty (internal vs vendor)?

Proposed dates: Tue Mar 8 or Thu Mar 10 (AM preferred). Budget: we have modest training credits — will loop finance if we need to expand.

A few must-haves:
- a one-page quick-reference for managers on ‘how to document a performance concern’
- a short rubric for calibration meetings
- a confidential channel/process for sensitive HR intake (not public Slack)

Can everyone weigh in on objectives and whether we should make this mandatory for anyone promoted in the last 6 months?

Thanks,
Ava Chen
People Ops Partner (People Enablement)
Redwood Inference

From: Elena P. <elena@peopleops-training.com>

Date: Sun, 7 Feb 2027 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: People Lead orientation & sensitive-HR playbook — pilot session scheduling

Thanks Ava — excited to pilot with Redwood. Draft agenda attached and a short note on format. Summary below:

- 9:00–9:30: Intro + policy refresh (Redwood performance review highlights) — vendor + internal HR co-lead
- 9:30–11:00: Scenario-based difficult-conversation roleplays (pairs, guided by faculty)
- 11:00–11:30: Documentation & escalation practicum (how to write a concern, evidence vs opinion)
- 11:30–12:00: Calibration primer & next steps for ongoing coaching

Attachments included: performance-training-agenda.pdf, sensitive-convo-roleplay-plan.docx

We recommend 2 internal facilitators (HR + a senior people lead) and 1 vendor coach. Pricing estimate is on page 3 of the agenda. If you want a condensed 90-minute version, we can do that as well but strongly advise the 3-hour slot for the roleplay.

Quick question: do you want participant names ahead of time so we can do pre-reads and assign roleplay tracks?

—Elena
PeopleOps Training (vendor)
[attachment: performance-training-agenda.pdf (pdf)]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Elena P. <elena@peopleops-training.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: People Lead orientation & sensitive-HR playbook — pilot session scheduling

Ava / Elena — this looks solid. A couple of edits/suggestions:

- Add a module (15–20 min) on legal/notice triggers (when to pause a conversation and escalate to HR for investigation). Neha, can you draft the bullets we need to cover?
- Include a short pre-read (one pager) on the new calibration rubric — Marissa, can you take point?
- I prefer Thu Mar 10 (AM). Can we aim for 9:00–12:00 PST?

Also — we should make this required for the cohort of people leads promoted since Sep 2026 and optional for managers promoted earlier. Purpose: reduce variance in how sensitive cases are handled across teams.

Grace
Head of People Partners
